## Description

Trains score-based generative diffusion models on cross-sectional fundamental and technical stock factor panels to synthesize realistic factor return scenarios for stress testing quantitative equity strategies.

## Where it may fit

Quantitative equity strategy stress testing, multi-factor portfolio scenario generation, factor crash simulation.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Hedge Funds, Systematic Factor Investing Desks.

## Required data

Cross-sectional fundamental factor panels, daily stock return matrices, macroeconomic indicator time series.

## Caveats

Reverse diffusion sampling requires numerical ODE solvers, increasing scenario generation time.
